detaileddescription.para: A pool allocator backed by a caller-provided byte array. All blocks are the same size. Allocation and free are O(1) via a freelist embedded in the free blocks themselves.
Block size is automatically rounded up to 4-byte alignment. Minimum block size is sizeof(void*) (4 bytes on 32-bit targets).
